title: CRITICAL: AgentChatPanel infinite render loop — unstable zustand selector breaks chat panel mount (1291 regression)
description:
RUNTIME-CONFIRMED via Playwright e2e (QA of 1291, commit 206edaa). The Agent tab does NOT render: clicking [data-testid=right-tab-agent] mounts AgentChatPanel which immediately throws "Maximum update depth exceeded" (React infinite re-render), so [data-testid=agent-chat-panel] never appears. This breaks the ENTIRE 1291 feature at runtime (history persistence, multi-thread switcher, active-thread loop) AND regresses the existing agent-chat-drives-stage.spec.ts oracle (it now times out waiting for the panel). The threadStore unit tests pass because they exercise the store in isolation and never MOUNT the panel -- classic "byte-presence tests are not runtime proof" gap.

ROOT CAUSE: AgentChatPanel.tsx line ~134: const threads = useThreadStore(selectThreadsByRecency). With zustand v5 (^5.0.2), a selector that returns a NEW reference on every call causes an infinite render loop. selectThreadsByRecency (threadStore.ts ~375) returns [...s.threads].sort(...) -- a brand-new array on every invocation -- so zustand's Object.is snapshot check always sees a change and re-renders forever. (selectActiveThread via .find() is referentially stable and OK.)

FIX OPTIONS: (a) memoize the derived sort in the component over a STABLE base selector, e.g. const rawThreads = useThreadStore(s => s.threads); const threads = useMemo(() => [...rawThreads].sort((a,b)=>b.updatedAt-a.updatedAt), [rawThreads]); -- or (b) use zustand's useShallow / a stable equality fn. Do NOT return a freshly-sorted array straight out of useThreadStore in v5.

ACCEPTANCE (runtime, not unit-only): agent-chat-drives-stage.spec.ts green again; a fresh e2e must mount the panel, send a turn, RELOAD and see the restored transcript, create a 2nd thread and confirm isolated histories, and confirm a follow-up turn continues the ACTIVE thread's history. No "Maximum update depth" pageerror in console. A ready-to-run verification spec already exists at apps/desktop/e2e/qa-1292-1291.spec.ts (its JOB 1 InstancePanel test passes today; the three 1291 chat tests will pass once this loop is fixed). NOTE: task 1293 (streaming-patch threading / persist-on-terminal / markdown memo) is a SEPARATE, lower-severity follow-up and does NOT address this mount-blocking loop -- fix this first.
